scope: Prevent demonstrable phantom right-clicks; not a native second-contact or daily-use RAW solution.

historical_device_evidence.limitation: Historical observation, not current device state. RAW samples are in-sample positives with no independent moving-single negatives or arbitrary-position/short-axis calibration.

source_refresh.finding: Implementation uses MAX_TOUCH_POINTS=2, register01 and14-byte reads. Reset/ID init contains no multitouch-enable write. README five-point claim is not proof of second-contact reports on this panel.

Again register01,14-byte reads and countbyte1; no verified enable sequence. Its unbounded count loop can exceed the read buffer; do not import this parser or infer physical capability from its advertised maximum.

changes: Normal native TWO records: first-pair fixed anchors with order-independent one-to-one matching suppress opposed-motion false right taps; moving single lift tails and staggered touchdown displacement also disqualify taps. No new controller write or synthetic contact.

RAW qualified TWO to ONE tail: tap eligibility requires the inferred tail to remain within existing12-unit tolerance of either original lobe; displaced/merged tails permanently suppress right taps. ONE is still not a proven single finger.
Both guards are tap-only: existing scroll mapping and mac-natural signs remain unchanged. Normal one-finger behavior, menu, USR1, charging and display layout are not intentionally changed.

Synthetic actual-C regressions include all four native poses,12/13 boundaries, record reorder, opposed motion, tail movement, staggered touchdown, no re-anchor, subsequent scrolling and clean release recovery. Mutation checks remove each guard to require detection of the original defect.

release_boundary.next_evidence: Verified same-panel multi-contact report/configuration, or independent RAW moving-single/close-contact negatives and short-axis calibration before promotion.
